cues.text: Test 3.
This is the IELTS listening test.
You will hear a number of different recordings and you will have to answer questions on what you hear.
There will be time for you to read the instructions and questions and you will have a chance to check your work.
All the recordings will be played once only.
The test is in four parts.
At the end of the test, you will be given ten minutes to transfer your answers to an answer sheet.
Now turn to part one.
Part one.
You will hear a woman phoning the owner of a house she is going to rent about companies that she could rent furniture from.
First, you have some time to look at questions one to five.
Now listen carefully and answer questions one to five.
Good morning.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: Hi, this is Shelley Meyer.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: I'm renting your house on Archwood Avenue.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: I'm due to move in next week.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: Oh yes, hello Ms. Meyer.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: What can I do for you?
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: When I viewed the house, I told you I'll most probably need to rent some furniture, at least until I know whether my temporary work contract is going to be made permanent.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: Yes, of course, I remember.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: And I said I could give you some information about furniture rental companies in the city.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: That's right.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: Well, the biggest company is called Peak Rentals.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: I've recommended them to other people and have always heard positive reports about them.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: Could you give me an idea of their costs?
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: Sure.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: I actually have one of their brochures here.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: It says the monthly price per room starts at $105 and goes up to $239.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: That depends on which rooms you need furniture for, of course.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: Sure.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: It's just to get a general idea of how much it's going to cost.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: And you said you had some positive feedback about this company?
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: Yes.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: People have mentioned that the furniture from Peak Rentals is more modern than any of the other companies.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: And also, once you place an order, the furniture will be delivered to you in just one or two days.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: That would be really helpful.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: Oh, and the brochure says that there's a special offer at the moment.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: If you rent living room furniture, I believe that's a set of chairs and a TV table, you'll also get a lamp at no extra cost.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: Okay, but you know, that price range you gave is more than I was hoping to pay.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: Then you could try Aaron and Oliver.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: Sorry.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: What and Oliver?
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: Aaron.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: Double A-R-O-N.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: Okay.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: Are they cheaper?
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: I'd say they're a mid-price company.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: But if you chose them, you need to be aware that they charge an extra 12% every month in case of damage.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: Oh, I see.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: I'd have to do the math carefully then.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: Right.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: But one helpful thing is that they also do cleaning for customers.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: For the furniture?
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: For the house.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: Oh, I see.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: I probably won't need that.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to ten.
Now listen and answer questions six to ten.
There's another company called Larch Furniture.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: It's quite new and it has the lowest prices in town.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: That's for both furniture and also electronic equipment.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: Well, that would be good.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: I'm not bringing much with me and I won't have much time to go shopping after I start my job.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: There are two things you need to know about Larch Furniture.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: First of all, you have to take out insurance on the furniture and you need to organize that yourself.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: That wouldn't be too hard.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: Also, you can't take out a contract for less than six months.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: But I figure that might not be a problem for you.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: You're renting the house for 12 months after all, aren't you?
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: Yes, okay, well...
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: Sorry to interrupt.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: I just thought of another furniture rental company.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: It's called Space Rentals and it's located very near to the house.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: Okay.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: I don't have any information about their charges, so it's best to use their app to find out what it would cost you to use them.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: Okay, thanks.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: I'll do that.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: One good thing about that company is that if you don't like the furniture once it's delivered, you can request exchanges, as long as you do that within a week of receiving it.
cues.speaker: LANDLORD

cues.text: That sounds really great.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: Okay, well, thanks very much.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: That's so helpful.
cues.speaker: SHELLEY

cues.text: That is the end of Part 1.
You now have one minute to check your answers to Part 1.
